name: BigCommerce
one_liner: BigCommerce provides REST and GraphQL APIs for managing store data, storefront, and integrations.
auth_notes: OAuth2 is used for all API accounts, with scopes limiting access to specific resources.
access_notes: API credentials can be created directly in the store control panel without any approval.

Generate API credentials Navigate to Settings > API Accounts in your store control panel.
